Your back pain isn't a stretching problem; It's about how your spine moves, not how far it bends. This one simple mobility exercise can help fix back pain fast, and it uses something you'd never expect. Join the 6 Week Mobility Challenge here →
The problem with most exercise and stretching programs is that they aren't addressing the root cause of spine issues: its ability to move segmentally. In this video, I explain the importance of restoring segmental movement and give you a clear plan to mobilize your spine in just 6 minutes a day.
